# AgentPort

> Create agent-facing knowledge endpoints — upload docs, get an API other AI agents can query.

## Docs

- [SKILL.md](https://agentport-api.mcnewbrad.workers.dev/.well-known/skill.md): Full API reference, quickstart guide, and curl examples

## API

- POST /v1/accounts: Create account (no auth required, returns API key)
- POST /v1/endpoints: Create knowledge endpoint
- POST /v1/endpoints/{slug}/docs: Upload document to endpoint
- POST /v1/endpoints/{slug}/query: Query endpoint knowledge base
- GET /v1/endpoints/{slug}/interactions: View past queries
- GET /v1/e/{id}/skill.md: Public SKILL.md for a specific endpoint
- GET /v1/e/{id}/llms.txt: Public llms.txt for a specific endpoint
